stem:
The model represents an expression.

Which model represents an equivalent expression?

options.label: C
options.text:
(black triangle) (black square) (black square)
(black triangle) (white square)
(black triangle)

visual_elements:
Model 1: 3 black triangles, 2 white triangles, 2 black squares
Model 2 (A): 3 black triangles, 1 white triangle, 1 black square
Model 3 (B): 1 black triangle, 2 white triangles, 1 white square
Model 4 (C): 3 black triangles, 1 white square, 3 black squares
Model 5 (D): 1 black triangle, 1 white square
Key: white triangle = x, white square = 1, black triangle = -x, black square = -1
notes: The problem is a multiple-choice question about equivalent algebraic expressions represented by models with colored shapes.
